title: 熔岩の咆哮
caption: colossal crushing boss song, slow heavy doom metal riffs, taiko and anvil strikes, roaring brass, molten distorted synths, aggressive industrial, taiko drums, roaring fire, distorted synths, volcano forge, powerful mature female alto rock diva vocal, low husky chest voice, strong belting, passionate and confident, Japanese lyrics, Japanese anime song, J-pop royal road progression, bittersweet melancholic yet uplifting, sorrowful piano and strings fused with breakbeat groove, ethereal reverb, upfront vocal
lyrics:
[Intro - taiko and anvil]

[Verse 1]
燃える大地に 立ち上がり
炎を吐いて 吠える怒り
巨大な腕が 地を割り
灰が降る中 ただ一人

[Pre-Chorus]
熱い風に 焼かれても
この足だけは 止めないで

[Chorus]
吠えろ 吠えろ 炎の果てまで
叫べ 叫べ 灰が降る中で
巨大な掌を くぐり抜けて
燃える心で 撃ち抜いて

[Instrumental Break - doom metal riffs and taiko]

[Chorus]
吠えろ 吠えろ 炎の果てまで
叫べ 叫べ 灰が降る中で
巨大な掌を くぐり抜けて
燃える心で 撃ち抜いて

[Outro - roaring fire]
